settings.visualStyle: Stalingrad 1942–1943 historical reenactment, embedded field-camera realism, shattered brick streets, ruined factories, broken stairwells, smoke-filled air, muted brown-grey wartime film palette, realistic Soviet uniforms and equipment, non-graphic urban combat, no modern objects.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. Follow one fictional Soviet urban defender through a ruined street, factory, stairwell, rubble crawl, brief recovery, overwatch and continued block-by-block movement. No dialogue or narrator. One primary action and one camera movement per scene.
settings.customVisualStyle: Claustrophobic urban 35mm field-film aesthetic with brick dust on clothing, broken windows, shafts of smoky light, natural handheld occlusion and restrained close combat.

movie.plotDetails: Fictional composite Soviet infantryman used as a continuity anchor inside a historically plausible Stalingrad urban battlefield.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create an immersive two-minute historical reenactment of urban fighting in Stalingrad. Follow one fictional Soviet defender through rubble-filled streets, a ruined industrial building, a damaged stairwell, close danger and quiet exhaustion. The environment should feel physically compressed and dangerous without showing graphic injury. No dialogue or narration. Do not keep combat constant; include waiting, listening and recovery beats.
movie.storySummary: A Soviet rifleman moves through a shattered city block and crosses into a ruined factory under fire. The section climbs a broken stairwell, passes through a breach, crawls across rubble and pauses in a dusty industrial hall. From a blown-out window the soldier studies the street before moving again. The episode ends with more ruined blocks ahead, making clear that the fight continues one building at a time.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP06 — Stalingrad: City of Fire

scenes.title: Street of Rubble
scenes.description: A shattered street opens beneath drifting smoke and hanging dust.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks with his section along a narrow path between rubble piles.
scenes.imageDescription: Stalingrad urban ruin, broken masonry, tram rail fragments, smoke, Soviet infantry, same soldier dusty but not yet heavily coated, muted 35mm color.
scenes.videoPrompt: Shoulder-height handheld follow weaving around rubble. Audio: boots on brick, distant artillery, falling debris, no speech.

scenes.title: Across the Street
scenes.description: The squad must cross an exposed gap between ruined facades.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman makes one short sprint across the street and reaches cover behind a collapsed wall.
scenes.imageDescription: Exposed rubble street, damaged facades, smoke, soldiers running one by one, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: One fast run-and-stop handheld move. Audio: boots, gear, distant sharp fire, brick chips.

scenes.title: Into the Factory
scenes.description: The section enters a broken industrial shell through a blasted opening.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman steps through a jagged doorway into a dim hall filled with steel beams and dust.
scenes.imageDescription: Destroyed factory interior, broken windows, twisted beams, Soviet infantry entering, smoky shafts of light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward handheld move through doorway into darker interior. Audio: boots on debris, metal creak, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Fire Between Columns
scenes.description: A brief firefight erupts across the industrial hall.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crouches behind a broken machine base and fires several controlled shots across the hall.
scenes.imageDescription: Industrial ruin, broken machinery, smoke, Soviet rifleman firing from cover, opposing threat spatially separated beyond columns.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low over-shoulder shot with rifle offset from frame center. Audio: controlled shots, echoes, metal impacts, no words.

scenes.title: Broken Stairwell
scenes.description: The section climbs a damaged stairwell toward an upper floor.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman climbs carefully over missing steps and stops at a half landing.
scenes.imageDescription: Cracked stairwell, exposed brick, dust, broken handrail, soldier climbing cautiously with rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: One upward tracking move following boots and lower body to the landing. Audio: concrete grit, breath, distant shots.

scenes.title: Through the Breach
scenes.description: A blasted wall opening connects the stairwell to another interior room.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman squeezes through the opening while keeping low.
scenes.imageDescription: Jagged breach through brick wall, dim room beyond, same soldier dirtier and covered in fine brick dust.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close handheld squeeze-through shot with brief lens occlusion from masonry. Audio: fabric scrape, brick grit, breathing.

scenes.title: Window Pause
scenes.description: The soldier freezes behind a blown-out window before exposing himself to the street.
scenes.actionDescription: He stays still, listens and slowly leans enough to study the road below.
scenes.imageDescription: Dark interior, shattered window frame, ruined street outside, soldier half concealed, no visible enemy required.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still shot with one slow lean toward the window. Audio: distant shots, wind through broken glass, breath.

scenes.title: Rubble Crawl
scenes.description: The section crosses a collapsed interior where standing would expose them.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman crawls over broken brick and timber behind a low wall remnant.
scenes.imageDescription: Ground-level rubble, brick fragments, splintered timber, dust-coated Soviet soldier crawling low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low crawling camera move through rubble. Audio: bricks shifting, fabric, breathing, distant combat.

scenes.title: Dust and Breath
scenes.description: A lull settles inside the factory as sunlight cuts through suspended dust.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman leans against a pillar, lowers his rifle and catches his breath.
scenes.imageDescription: Dusty factory hall, smoky sunbeams, tired soldier against concrete pillar, rifle resting low, no action nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still close shot with a subtle push-in. Audio: breathing, distant artillery, loose metal tapping.

scenes.title: Back Through Machinery
scenes.description: The section resumes movement through the industrial ruin.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman moves between ruined machines and follows two comrades deeper into the structure.
scenes.imageDescription: Large factory interior, damaged machinery, drifting smoke, Soviet section moving in file.
scenes.videoPrompt: Tracking shot weaving around machinery. Audio: boots, gear, metal creaks, distant fire.

scenes.title: Street Overwatch
scenes.description: From an upper opening the soldier watches a smoke-filled street before the next move.
scenes.actionDescription: He braces one hand on the wall and scans left to right across the street below.
scenes.imageDescription: Elevated view from broken building, rubble street, smoke, distant movement separated across urban terrain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow lateral scan from behind cover, no firing. Audio: wind, distant engines, sporadic shots.

scenes.title: Down to the Street
scenes.description: The unit descends and emerges into another destroyed lane.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman follows the section through a doorway and onto the street.
scenes.imageDescription: New ruined lane, smoke, rubble, soldier emerging low from doorway, same accumulated dust and gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Handheld emergence shot from dark interior into brighter smoke-filled street. Audio: boots, wind, distant combat.

scenes.title: No Safe Corner
scenes.description: The soldier checks a ruined building corner before the squad passes.
scenes.actionDescription: He leans around the corner, then motions nonverbally for the section to move.
scenes.imageDescription: Broken brick corner, shattered doorway, Soviet soldier checking angle, smoke beyond.
scenes.videoPrompt: One cautious lean-and-return move. Audio: loose brick, breathing, distant gunfire, no intelligible speech.

scenes.title: City of Fire
scenes.description: A wider view reveals several ruined blocks and smoke columns beyond the section.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stops beside a rubble pile while the camera discovers the scale of destruction ahead.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide vertical Stalingrad ruin, many damaged buildings, smoke columns, tiny infantry figures, soldier foreground small in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow panoramic reveal from soldier to cityscape. Audio: wind, distant artillery, scattered fires.

scenes.title: Block by Block
scenes.description: The section disappears around another broken corner and the fight continues beyond view.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman follows the section out of sight toward the next block.
scenes.imageDescription: Long ruined street corridor, Soviet soldiers receding through smoke, same lead soldier identifiable by silhouette and gear, no victory imagery.
scenes.videoPrompt: Long rear follow shot ending as the group vanishes behind rubble. Audio: boots, distant gunfire, wind through ruins, restrained score tail.

characters.name: Urban Defender
characters.description: Anonymous Soviet infantryman in historically plausible Stalingrad-era field uniform, steel helmet, rifle and worn field gear, increasingly coated in brick dust.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep the same face, helmet, rifle and uniform. Brick dust and grime increase after factory entry and persist to the end.

props.personalProps: rifle, helmet, ammunition pouches, small field gear
